text: repository contains final project BST260 (Fall 2026) Harvard T.H. Chan School Public Health. project investigates anthropometric measurements using two publicly available datasets: Mendeley Body Measurements dataset National Health Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), August 2021–August 2023.

title: Comparative Analysis of Anthropometric Measurements
text: main objectives project : Explore distributions age, height, waist circumference. Examine associations demographic characteristics anthropometric measurements. Compare data quality measurement characteristics across two datasets. Identify challenges associated integrating datasets collected different populations using different measurement protocols. Apply R programming, statistical analysis, data visualization generate reproducible findings.
